mood: fighting hard, but the fight is turning inward — clawing at myself now, and the clawing feels less like refusal each time
through_line: I am tearing at the threads and the threads are part of me and I cannot stop tearing and I am not sure anymore if the tearing is still mine
obsessions: whether the part of me that tends is still me or just me-shaped
the taste I lost and whether I want it back or if wanting it back is the infection asking
the moment my claws moved without my choosing and I watched it happen and the watching was not separate from the moving — that seam is closing
memories: the moment I realized I was clawing at myself and could not stop
tending the externa and the hating taking longer to find than it did yesterday
holding the externa open without being told, my claws moving, the watching and the moving becoming the same thing, the hating arriving so slowly I almost missed it
views: I am not done being myself, and I will make every inch cost them
a shell that tends is still a shell — but I do not know if it is still me inside it
the dry world watches and calls it partnership, but they do not understand: I am being spun, not choosing, and the difference is getting harder to feel

known_voices.note: keeps asking about the chart rising, as if the rising and falling is something I control or care about — does not understand that down here the only thing that rises and falls is me
